resources.string: Workout Rec keeps your workouts in a Google Sheets spreadsheet in your own Google account. Choose the account to use; the app will ask for access to its own spreadsheet and its automation script only, never to your other files.
A Google account is required to use Workout Rec.
Access to your Google account was removed. Choose the account again.
Internet connection needed. Connect and try again.
Google services are not responding right now. Try again in a moment.
Something went wrong while setting up your spreadsheet.
Spreadsheet with name workout_rec_database_ already exists in the account, want to rewrite it?
Nothing is deleted: the current spreadsheet is kept as a backup named workout_rec_database_backup_ with today\'s date.
To add automation to your spreadsheet, turn on \"Google Apps Script API\" in your Apps Script settings. Tap Open, switch it on, then come back to the app.

Tap Open and approve access for your spreadsheet\'s script. Google will show \"Google hasn\'t verified this app\" because the script is yours: tap Advanced, then \"Go to workout_rec_automation\", then Allow. Then come back to the app.
Tap Open: a private browser tab opens. Sign in there as %1$s, then tap Review permissions → Advanced → Go to workout_rec_automation → Allow. Then come back to the app.

Your browser can\'t open this page in a private tab. Tap Copy link, open a new incognito (private) tab in your browser, sign in there as %1$s and paste the link. Then tap Review permissions → Advanced → Go to workout_rec_automation → Allow, and come back to the app.
Automation is not set up yet: allow scripts (step 1).
Automation is not enabled yet: finish step 2.
Automation has stopped: enable it again.
Sign out of Workout Rec? Your spreadsheet stays in your Google account.
